name: Zoho Desk
oneLiner: Multichannel help desk in the Zoho suite with ticketing, self-service portals, automation and the Zia AI assistant.
bestFor: Budget-conscious support teams, especially those already using Zoho CRM or other Zoho apps.

updates.text: Zoho launched its own Zia LLM plus Zia Agents, a no-code Agent Studio, an agent marketplace and an MCP server across its apps.
From 7 July 2026 Zia AI features such as sentiment analysis, auto tags and Zia notifications were extended to all paid Zoho Desk editions (Standard and above).

features: Tickets from email, social media (Instagram, Facebook, X), web forms, phone and live chat in one view
Instant messaging channels: WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook Messenger, Telegram, WeChat and Line (Standard and up)
Zia AI: sentiment analysis, auto tags, reply suggestions, anomaly alerts (full Zia on Professional and up; sentiment, auto tags and notifications on Standard since July 2026)
AI Agents built with your own LLM key or Zoho's LLM, with pre-built agents and up to 30M free tokens a month
Answer Bot, knowledge base, community forum and self-service help center (Standard and up); multilingual help center in 40+ languages (Professional)
Assignment rules, SLAs, multi-level escalations, workflows and Blueprint process automation (Blueprints on Professional and up)
Customer happiness ratings (CSAT) and custom reports and dashboards
Telephony integration (Professional and up) and multi-department support
Integration with Zoho CRM, Zoho Analytics and other Zoho apps

pricing.text: Free plan with 3 users. Paid plans per user per month, billed annually: Express $7, Standard $14, Professional $23, Enterprise $40; billed monthly: Express $9, Standard $20, Professional $35, Enterprise $50. 15-day free trial of any paid plan, after which the account drops to the free plan. Light agents $6 per month on Professional and Enterprise (Enterprise includes 50 free light users).

notes: November 2026: zoho.com/desk/pricing.html shows prices in the visitor's currency; the USD figures come from the page's own price file (zoho.com/sites/zweb/json/pricing/desk-pricing-val.json), and they match the earlier third-party consensus. The page doesn't state an agent cap for Express (its FAQ mentions a 5-user limit for Standard, which may be out of date), so the review gives no cap. G2 rating from a search-result snippet of the G2 reviews page (4.4 from 7,820 reviews, August 2026); counts vary slightly by page. Mercedes-Benz India is listed on casestudies.com's Zoho Desk page; I couldn't open Zoho's own story. The Zia LLM launch was suite-wide; Desk-specific availability of Zia Agents wasn't confirmed, so the review describes it as a Zoho-wide launch.
pros: Free plan for 3 users and paid plans from $7 per user per month, billed annually
Close links to Zoho CRM, Zoho Analytics and other Zoho apps
Email, social, web forms, phone, live chat and messaging apps such as WhatsApp and Instagram in one ticket view
Self-service through a knowledge base, community forum and Answer Bot (Standard and up)

cons.text: The free plan covers 3 users with limited capabilities (email ticketing)
Blueprints, telephony, multi-department support and the full Zia AI set start on Professional ($23 per user per month, billed annually)
Monthly billing costs more: Standard is $20 per user per month billed monthly versus $14 billed annually
A general help desk, so restaurant-specific work such as replying to reviews across locations needs another tool
